The Weaponsmith

Babur, the Village's craftsman, must know much about magical things. Perhaps he has heard of the magic orb. The bandits also need a new weaponsmith, as their old one is failing. Persuade or force Babur to join them.

Objectives

Get into the Village

Slip Babur the note

Plant the note for the elder
